title: Langevin Flow Maps: Efficient Molecular Dynamics and Transition Path Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.05998v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Molecular dynamics simulations proceed by integrating the Langevin equations over many small femtosecond timesteps. This poses a challenge for estimating ensemble properties and transition dynamics that occur on much longer timescales. We introduce Langevin Flow Maps, which extend machine-learned force-fields to additionally learn the stochastic Langevin integrator. We show that Langevin Flow Maps enable large-timestep molecular dynamics and recover accurate dynamical properties of the system, while running an order of magnitude faster than current machine-learned force fields. Further, by training on a diverse molecular dataset, we demonstrate a path towards transferable Langevin Flow Maps.

translated_title: 朗之万流映射：高效分子动力学与过渡路径采样
translated_abstract: 分子动力学模拟通过在许多飞秒级的小时间步长上积分朗之万方程来进行。这给估计发生在长得多的时间尺度上的系综性质和转变动力学带来了挑战。我们提出了朗之万流映射，它对机器学习力场进行了扩展，使其额外学习随机朗之万积分器。我们证明朗之万流映射能够实现大时间步长的分子动力学模拟，并能恢复系统的准确动力学性质，同时运行速度比现有机器学习力场快一个数量级。此外，通过在多样化的分子数据集上进行训练，我们展示了通往可迁移朗之万流映射的路径。
tldr: 提出朗之万流映射，通过扩展机器学习力场以额外学习随机朗之万积分器，实现大时间步长的高效分子动力学模拟，在准确恢复系统动力学性质的同时速度提升一个数量级，并展示了向可迁移模型发展的路径。
en_tdlr: Langevin Flow Maps extend machine-learned force fields to additionally learn the stochastic Langevin integrator, enabling large-timestep molecular dynamics that accurately recovers dynamical properties while running an order of magnitude faster than current approaches, with a path toward transferable models.
